description:
Your folders, the most recently changed first, each with item_count, up to 4 cover
    thumbnails and its share link when shared. With hook_id or find_id, each folder also
    has contains: the item id when it holds that video (any run's copy), else null.
    Returns {"folders": [...], "count"}. Same as GET /v1/folders. Free.

find_id.title: Find Id

kind.description: only "short", "long" or "packaging"; leave out for every tab
kind.title: Kind
